notes.title: Wispy Dreams V1.03
notes.content:
A quick fix for a few serious bugs!

- The Keyblade achievement can now be unlocked.
- In the last patch, I fixed a sound bug with Tom, the enemy that chases you after time runs out. Naturally, this caused the game to softlock during one of the later bosses, so I've fixed that now too.
- Hopefully fixed the bug where the insect enemy sometimes flies out of the screen and leaves you stuck.

notes.title: First patch!
notes.content:
There's been a problem on some PC's where the player's kicks aren't being registered and I'm trying to investigate it. It does not seem tied to framerate or even specs, but I've reworked the code behind it so I'm hoping it works now.

Other changes:

[list]
[*] Insect projectiles disappear once that enemy is defeated
[*] Bug fixed where you could exit the sanctuaries if you had enough movespeed
[*] Some sound glitches fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Wispy Dreams available now!
notes.content:
[h1]Wispy Dreams has now been released![/h1]

We hope you'll be able to join us on this adorable adventure through the Wispy Isles! It's been a long 3 years of development, but we can finally say that our game is finished and feature complete. Within you'll find an abundance of levels, bosses, secret levels, secret bosses... In fact, there's so many secrets, we'll be very impressed if anyone is able to find the true secret ending!

We also want give an [b]enormously big thanks[/b] to everyone who wishlisted our game and tried out the demo. It means the world to see people enjoying our game! Remember to give it a shot in co-op, it really is much more chaotic and fun with a buddy!
